verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents automatic identity stitching, which amends prior anonymous cookie-based records once a user is identified. Its Profile Builder creates warehouse customer profiles from identify traits, with custom JavaScript logic over up to a year of events. That covers anonymous-to-known stitching and configurable profile logic, but cross-device merging and explicit resolution rules are not clearly documented. missing for 10: explicit cross-device merge documentation, documented identity-resolution rule set (match keys, merge precedence, graph handling), independent or hands-on corroboration.
